 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Tile the grid in four rotations: original, clockwise, counterclockwise, 180°."""
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*g[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*g)][::-1]
    half = [row[:] for row in g] + [row[:] for row in ccw]
    other = [row[:] for row in cw] + [row[:] for row in [r[::-1] for r in g[::-1]]]
    return [half[i] + other[i] for i in range(len(g))] + [half[i] + other[i] for i in range(len(g), 2 * len(g))]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test = [[1,6,6,6,6,6,5,6],[7,3,6,7,3,6,5,6],[6,6,6,6,6,6,5,1],[6,4,6,5,6,6,6,6],[3,4,6,4,7,1,5,6],[6,5,6,3,6,6,6,5],[4,3,6,6,6,6,6,6],[6,4,6,4,6,5,1,1]]
